[[File:Jinn_Skywalker.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jinn and his parents, in Darth Vader's vision]]
'''Jinn Skywalker''' was the unreal, but dreamed-of son of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader envisioned of Jinn's existence having happened had he not turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and Padmé had not [[Death/Legends|died]] in childbirth. Vader chose the name Jinn in honor of his deceased mentor [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].

==Biography==
In [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader's]] visions, Anakin and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé]] named their son after [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Anakin's first informal [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].

Later, Anakin and Jinn watched as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] Padmé Amidala-Skywalker addressed the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]].

Anakin barely saved his son from getting killed while hunting [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]].
